title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
description: Classic Italian garlic and olive oil pasta, ready in 20 minutes.

steps.text: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Gently fry the garlic in olive oil over low heat until golden.
Add red pepper flakes, then toss in the drained pasta with a splash of pasta water.
Finish with parsley and season with salt.

title: Huevos Rancheros
description: Mexican breakfast of fried eggs on warm tortillas with a quick tomato salsa.

steps.text: Soften the onion, garlic and jalapeño in half the oil, then add the tomato and simmer 5 minutes to make a salsa.
Warm the black beans in a small pot and season with salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set.
Top each tortilla with beans, an egg and salsa, then sprinkle with cilantro.

title: Chana Masala
description: Indian chickpea curry in a spiced tomato and onion sauce.

steps.text: Cook the onion in oil over medium heat until golden, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger and the spices and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomato and simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Stir in the chickpeas and a splash of water, then simmer 10 minutes more.
Season with salt and finish with cilantro. Serve with rice or naan.

title: Miso Soup
description: Simple Japanese soup with tofu, seaweed and green onion.

steps.text: Soak the wakame in warm water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Bring the dashi to a gentle simmer.
Dissolve the miso in a ladle of the hot dashi, then stir it back into the pot.
Add the tofu and wakame and heat through without boiling.
Serve topped with green onion.

title: Maple Pancakes
description: Fluffy Canadian-style pancakes served with maple syrup.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: melted, plus more for the pan

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the milk, egg and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir until just combined; a few lumps are fine.
Cook 1/4 cup portions on a buttered pan over medium heat until bubbles form, then flip.
Serve warm with maple syrup.

title: Greek Salad
description: Fresh Greek salad with tomato, cucumber, red onion, olives and feta.

steps.text: Combine the tomato, cucumber, red onion, pepper and olives in a large bowl.
Whisk the olive oil, vinegar, oregano and a pinch of salt.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss gently.
Place the feta on top and sprinkle with a little more oregano.

title: Hummus
description: Smooth Middle Eastern chickpea dip, great as a snack with pita or vegetables.

steps.text: Blend the tahini and lemon juice for 1 minute until creamy.
Add the garlic, olive oil, cumin and salt and blend again.
Add the chickpeas and blend, adding reserved liquid a spoonful at a time until smooth.
Serve drizzled with olive oil and sprinkled with paprika.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
description: Quick Chinese-style chicken and vegetable stir-fry with a soy-ginger sauce.

steps.text: Stir-fry the chicken in half the oil over high heat until cooked through, then set aside.
Add the remaining oil, then the broccoli, pepper and carrot, and stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook 30 seconds.
Return the chicken, add the soy sauce and cornstarch mixture, and toss until glossy.
Top with green onion and serve with rice.

title: Vanilla Cake
description: A simple vanilla layer cake with buttercream icing.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease two 8-inch cake pans.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Add the flour and milk in turns, mixing until just smooth.
Divide between the pans and bake for 30 minutes. Cool completely.
Beat the butter, icing sugar and vanilla until smooth, then ice the cooled cake.
